<!-- pr-reviewer: 6c0c62c61816ca244daed82845a184bf6e02a854 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Behaviour check, old vs new: `tool_table` and `tools_of` moved verbatim (same grid columns T / Tool / Size / Ops / Edit, same `tool_numbers::clash` error, same `open_tool_editor` hop). The readout uses the same `for_setup` rows and the same `units::len(.., u, 2)` and `setup_sheet::minutes` formatting for Cut, Rapid and Est; "Setup total" uses the same `tool_list::setup_minutes`. No column dropped (the old "N ops / N changes" text became the Ops and Changes columns; only the singular/plural suffix is gone, as the grid makes it moot). Both empty-state messages are verbatim.
- Both export rows (`tool_list_export`, `sheet_footer`) are the existing functions, unchanged, so export goes through the same dialogs. The page still writes nothing: only the existing `OpenToolEditor` hop. No new state.
- Layering holds (ui reads camcraft_app, no sys_*/world writes); no unwrap/expect/panic; no snapshot PNG, Cargo, build.rs, scripts or process file touched.
- Files: `tool_list_page.rs` 155 lines, `setup_pages.rs` 188, test file 50; provenance on the new modules; `pages.rs` shrinks by 35 (still far over, pre-existing).
- Follows #1440's pattern: named `layout::group`s, one small weak helper line, readout at the foot. Decision file records the `even_row` / #1438 reasoning.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main at 0fa183de; merge was already up to date)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD crates/ui, `--test-threads=1`) | 676 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| same, default parallel threads | 672 passed, 4 failed, all `law_tests::gizmo_tests::*` (unrelated to this PR; passes single-threaded) |
| ui suites boundary / boundary_picks / sinker_setup / theme_files | 3 / 6 / 1 / 14 passed |
| the 3 tool_list tests (2 new pins + `the_tool_list_page_exports_the_setups_tools`) | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |

Mutation checks (each reverted after): renaming "Time and travel", renaming "Export", renaming "Est (min)", changing "Setup total", changing either empty-state message each turn at least one pin red. Renaming the group makes both red.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The layout pin only reads the "Size" and "Est (min)" headers. Dropping the Rapid column (or Tool/Ops/Changes/Cut) leaves both pins green (checked: removing "Rapid" passes). Asserting the full header row would pin "no dropped column" too.
2. The helper line is present for the two tables but the Export group has none, and the Export rows are not `even_row` (deliberate, #1438); revisit after #1438 lands as the decision file says.
3. The PR body says screenshots are "attached below" but none are in the body (the comment says the user will attach them).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 6c0c62c61816ca244daed82845a184bf6e02a854 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**, with one owed item that is not a code blocker: the before/after screenshots (below).

**What looks good**
- Layout only: no command, parameter or project-file change. The page reads the world (`camcraft_app::tool_list`, `tool_numbers`, `model`) exactly as before, so layering ui -> app and everything-is-a-command are unchanged; the Open-editor hop and both export rows are reused.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added. New code lives in `tool_list_page.rs` (155 lines), moving `tool_table` and `tool_list_section` out of the oversized `pages.rs` / `setup_pages.rs`; provenance lines present.
- Structural tests updated: `tests/tool_list_page.rs` pins group order, table under its group, exports last, and the empty-state messages (kept verbatim).
- Decision file `docs/decisions/1440-toollist-page-tidy.md` present and explains the #1438 overlap. No snapshot PNG, no Cargo, build.rs, .github or process file touched, so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump owed. UI text is plain English.
- Body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #1440`; no closing keyword; commits are conventional.

**Results merged with main (0fa183de), on the self-hosted runner:** https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43472505559 - conclusion success.
- Quick gate: ui suites ok, 0 failed (1.3 min wall).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- No `cfg(windows)` or per-OS values in the diff, so no local re-run owed. GitHub reports the PR as MERGEABLE.

**Owed for the maintainer (not a code blocker)**
1. Screenshots: the body says "before/after attached below" but none are attached, and the author's comment says the user is to attach them (with and without tools). Per the UI-PR rule they are needed before this is offered for merge.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Not exercised by the author: a multi-tool document with several setups, and a real narrow window by hand; the sideways scroll is only checked structurally.
- Export buttons stay as `browser_files::button` rather than `even_row` to avoid a clash with #1438; revisit after it lands.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
